sections.title: 1 · State
sections.description: Cells and signals become `@state accessor x = v`:  read `this.x`, write `this.x = v`, fresh at once and tracked;  booleans read as English

sections.title: 2 · Mirror pairs
sections.description: A Cell plus a plain field (or wrapper, or setter) kept for a synchronous read merges into ONE `@state` accessor;  every name that disappears has its own row

sections.title: 3 · Controlled attributes
sections.description: `this.controlled("open", false)` and its `isOpen()` wrapper become `@controlled("open") accessor isOpen = false`;  a user change is `this.requestChange("isOpen", next, announce)`

sections.title: 4 · Derived values
sections.description: `createMemo` fields become plain `get x()` (cheap:  spell measured memoizing ~2x slower), `@derived get x()` only for costly ones (loops, parsing, class strings, new DOM);  no-arg value methods become getters

sections.title: 5 · Attribute reads and typed views
sections.description: The vocabulary gives a getter per attribute, converted:  `this.attrs.displayTime` becomes `this.displayTime`;  typed views (`common`, `dialogAttrs`, `sourceAttribute()`) and attribute-only methods go

sections.title: 6 · Raw attributes
sections.description: `new E.HostAttribute({ host, name })` becomes `this.attributes["aria-label"]`:  the raw DOM string (`string | null`), tracked, internal only

sections.title: 7 · Methods and getters that answer yes / no
sections.description: An English name;  a getter when it takes no arguments (`get isDisabled()`), a method when it does (`hasContent(name)`)

sections.title: 8 · Setters and actions
sections.description: A `setX(v)` that only writes becomes `this.x = v`;  setter closures go;  an action that sends an event stays a method with a verb name (`open(event)`, `requestClose()`)

sections.title: 9 · CSS states
sections.description: Each `hostStates()` entry becomes `@cssState("<state>")` on the member it reads (or a small getter);  the `hostStates()` overrides go

sections.title: 10 · Effects
sections.description: An effect that reads members and does one thing becomes `@onChange("a", "b") onXChanged()` (it may return a cleanup);  conditional, per-item or object-building effects stay explicit

sections.title: 11 · Handlers
sections.description: Event handlers and moment callbacks are `on...`:  `onKeyDown`, `onLoaded`, `onError`, `onMount`;  handlers already named `on...` aren't listed unless something else changes

sections.title: 12 · Class config and base-class names
sections.description: `@proto static` config and the base class's own names, mostly Owen's `// CLAUDE:` notes pre-filled;  where Claude would push back, the note says so

sections.title: 13 · Runtime flags
sections.description: The `UI.browser` flags controllers read:  `supports.x` already reads as English and keeps the platform's feature names
